name: Pavement 1

weightBudget.basis: One 35 mm sandstone pavement tile, rounded cobbles and shallow joints; 1024/512 colour atlases, lower resolution normal/ORM and Meshopt geometry.

reviewNotes: PDF page 2. Native insertion taper reaches the full 35 mm body at z=10 mm; preserve body above that datum. Top cobbles are 17.2–19.26 mm. Earth sides and warm weathered sandstone, local dirt in joints; no integrated furniture. Stone palette warmed after direct comparison with the author PDF; preserve the already confirmed geometry, UV and placement.
